brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:35c1686d-5066-4600-a.title: Production Technician
brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:35c1686d-5066-4600-a.description: ABOUT BRINC: At BRINC, we are redefining public safety with an innovative ecosystem of life-saving tools. Our journey started with the development of drones and ruggedized throw phones, designed to access unsafe areas and establish communication to de-escalate situations. Today, we've expanded into creating and deploying 911 response networks, where drones are dispatched to 911 calls to provide real-time visual data, enhancing safety and enabling de-escalation-focused responses. Our cutting-edge solutions are utilized by over 600 public safety agencies across America and the company has raised over $150M from investors, including Index Ventures, Motorola Solutions, Sam Altman, Dylan Field, Mike Volpe, Alexandr Wang and more. At BRINC, we are committed to recruiting the world's best talent to join us in our mission to support first responders in saving lives. ABOUT THIS ROLE: As a Production Technician, you will play a hands-on role in bringing our products to life. With foundational skills already in place, you will perform detailed work, such as precision soldering, troubleshooting and collaborating with other teams to improve processes. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Product Assembly: - Fabricate and assemble components using schematics, diagrams and written instructions. - Read and/or create assembly work instructions, repair manuals and liaise with other departments to assemble products. - Perform micro-soldering, rework and reflow tasks. - Build prototype models based on technical guidelines. - Manage and install cables, wiring, splicing as needed. - Testing, Troubleshooting & Quality Assurance: - Inspect, analyze and troubleshoot systems and equipment. - Run tests and interpret results to make effective recommendations. - Diagnose and repair electronic and mechanical issues in prototypes or production models. - Determine material or replacement needs and a logical method for repair; take appropriate action to meet those needs and make repairs. - Repair, install and inspect electronics or electronic systems as directed through verbal or written instructions, diagrams, drawings or specifications. - Create or adapt parts as needed to make repairs and improve the performance of various electronics. - Ensure all builds meet established quality standards and specifications. - Perform safety checks to ensure design plans are feasible in various conditions. - Documentation: - Maintain accurate records of assembly processes, testing results, repairs and any modifications. - Write reports, and follow safety regulations and preventative maintenance plans. - Provide feedback on design or process improvements to enhance production efficiency. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: - Work closely with engineers and other team members to meet production goals. - Follow and contribute to safety protocols and workplace cleanliness. QUALIFICATIONS: - Associate degree in avionics, electronics, or a similar field; or equivalent relevant experience. - Ability to use hand and power tools. - Ability to use diagnostic tools. - Ability to understand and utilize work instructions and technical manuals. - Strong analytical skills and ability to work independently. - Ability to lift up to 49lbs. - Ability to sit, stand or be on your feet for extended periods of time. PREFERRED SKILLS: - Ability to troubleshoot electrical and mechanical repairs. - Experience fixing and maintaining drones and knowledge of different drone systems. - Basic knowledge of drone operation and maintenance. - Understanding of quality control processes and documentation. BRINC CULTURE VALUES: - Try the hard stuff - Be innovative - Invent the future - Move fast - Listen to end-users - Strive for excellence - Don’t build a dystopia - Be frugal - Save lives through technology If you’re interested in this role and in joining BRINC, we hope you’ll apply. compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.title: Registered Nurse Preop/PACU
compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.description: Location: Coastal Virginia Surgery Center Address: 580 City Center Blvd Ste 300, Newport News, VA 23606 Website: Coastal Virginia Surgery Center https://coastalvirginiasurgerycenter.com/ Coastal Virginia Surgery Center is an ambulatory surgery center located in Newport News, VA. With two operating rooms and two procedure rooms, the center provides high-quality, cost-effective outpatient surgical and procedural care primarily for Orthopedics, Spine, Podiatry, and Pain Management. Owned and operated in partnership with BSMH and Compass Surgical Partners (an ASC Management organization), the center combines advanced technology with compassionate, patient-centered care in a convenient setting. Role Summary The Registered Nurse (RN) supports pre-op, PACU, and stepdown patient care. This position is responsible for assessing patients, delivering individualized nursing care, monitoring recovery, and collaborating with the surgical team to ensure safe, efficient procedures and optimal outcomes. What You’ll Do - Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patient care in perioperative settings - Monitor patient status and respond to changes during recovery - Document accurately and communicate effectively with team members and patients - Maintain sterile environments and adhere to safety protocols - Support patient education and post-op instructions What You’ll Bring - Graduate of an accredited RN program - Current VA RN license (unencumbered) - At least 1 year of perioperative nursing experience (within last 3–5 years) - Current BLS (ACLS required within 6 months) - Preferred: Member of the Association of Operating Room Nurses (AORN) - Strong clinical judgment, communication, and teamwork skills Physical & Work Environment Requirements - Frequent standing, walking, lifting, and manual dexterity - Exposure to surgical environments, equipment, and patient care areas - Full-time, on-site position (Monday–Friday) Compensation & Benefits - Competitive pay with medical, dental, and vision insurance - 401(k), PTO, and paid holidays - Opportunities for ongoing education and professional growth - Supportive, team-oriented work environment

emergence-emergence:ashbyhq:f4ebf2ee-361.description: Senior Implementation Consultant, Emergence | Remote - India | Full-Time Who We Are Emergence is a thematic holding company backed by the Pritzker Organization focused exclusively on acquiring and scaling category-defining software businesses. We invest in focused portfolios and specialized operating groups with deep domain expertise. We combine operational rigor with a growth equity mindset, driving sustainable ARR growth and industry-leading customer outcomes. The Mission Own end-to-end ERP implementations and financial integrations for portfolio companies during M&A and scaling phases. What You'll Do - Lead 3-5 concurrent ERP implementations across Intacct, Xero, and QuickBooks from requirements through cutover delivery. - Design chart of accounts architecture and multi-entity consolidation structures that scale with company growth. - Execute data migrations with zero material reconciliation exceptions and audit-ready documentation. - Build and oversee API and middleware integrations between ERP and ancillary systems like Bill.com http://Bill.com, Ramp, and Brex. - Reduce month-end close cycle time by 20-30% through workflow automation and process redesign. - Create SOP documentation and training materials that enable finance teams to operate independently post-implementation. What We're Looking For Must-haves - 5+ years hands-on experience with at least two of: Intacct, Xero, QuickBooks Desktop, or QuickBooks Online. - Expertise in chart of accounts design, multi-entity accounting, intercompany eliminations, and statutory consolidations. - Track record executing 3+ full-cycle ERP implementations or migrations with measurable, documented outcomes. - Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, COSO internal controls frameworks, and financial reporting process configuration. - Demonstrated ability to design and oversee API integrations or middleware solutions, not just conceptual knowledge. - Experience managing cross-functional projects and collaborating remotely across time zones asynchronously. Nice-to-haves - CA, CPA, or CMA certification or equivalent semi-qualified CA with 3+ years relevant experience. - Technical depth in SQL, REST APIs, or middleware platforms to enable faster integrations. - Experience supporting financial audits post-ERP implementation and structuring systems for auditability. Who you are You've led multiple ERP implementations from discovery through go-live. You spot gaps in requirements early, propose solutions unprompted, and document decisions thoroughly. You acknowledge when initial approaches need rework and explain what you learned. You test edge cases in data migrations that weren't explicitly required. You push back on timelines when you believe scope isn't feasible without degrading financial controls. You mentor junior team members on stakeholder management and change resistance. You operate independently across time zones and communicate risks in writing with specific mitigation proposals before they impact delivery. What We Offer - $35,000 per annum - Remote work from India - Opportunity to drive financial system strategy across a portfolio of growing software businesses - Direct exposure to PE-backed scaling, M&A integration, and operational excellence frameworks

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7bdbcdab-4f9e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud Support Engineer (Night Shift - US timing) based in India. This is a remote, customer-facing technical support role focused on helping enterprise customers maintain reliable, high-performing digital services. You’ll troubleshoot complex issues across web performance, media delivery, security, and edge computing environments. The role combines strong networking and Linux expertise with programming knowledge and a customer-first mindset. You’ll lead technical investigations, coordinate with internal teams globally, and remain accountable for customer issues through resolution. Working with customers primarily in U.S. regions, you’ll communicate through tickets, email, and online calls while maintaining clear technical documentation. The position offers exposure to large-scale cloud and internet technologies and opportunities to develop deep subject-matter expertise. It is an excellent environment for engineers who stay calm under pressure, enjoy solving challenging problems, and want to grow within a global technical organization. Act as a trusted technical partner for customers in U.S. regions, troubleshooting and mitigating complex issues across cloud, web performance, media, security, and edge computing services. Lead technical investigations across globally distributed cloud and internet infrastructure, identifying root causes and implementing or recommending effective solutions. Own customer issues from initial investigation through resolution, maintaining clear communication and appropriate expectations throughout the support lifecycle. Provide technical assistance through ticketing systems, email, and online calls, ensuring interactions are accurately documented and followed through. Collaborate with internal engineering, product, and support teams across different time zones to resolve complex or escalated technical problems. Apply knowledge of networking protocols and Linux environments to diagnose connectivity, application, performance, and infrastructure-related issues. Analyze application logs and command-line outputs to investigate technical problems and determine appropriate remediation steps. Maintain and leverage internal knowledge resources to improve troubleshooting efficiency and consistency. Contribute feedback that helps improve internal tools, support procedures, documentation, and customer-facing processes. Continuously develop technical expertise and work toward becoming a subject matter expert in relevant products and technologies. Maintain a calm, empathetic, and professional approach when handling technically complex or high-pressure customer situations. Requirements 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in technical support, cloud support, network operations, application support, or a comparable customer-facing engineering environment. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. Strong understanding of standard internet and networking protocols, including TCP/IP, UDP, QUIC, DNS, HTTP, and BGP. Hands-on experience working with Linux, particularly Bash/Shell command-line environments and application log analysis. Demonstrable programming experience in languages such as Python or Java. Familiarity with web technologies such as HTML and JavaScript. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical problems methodically and identify root causes. Excellent customer-service orientation and experience providing business-to-business technical support. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to customers and internal stakeholders. You’ll serve as a key point of contact for clients and tenants, building strong relationships while ensuring properties are managed efficiently. Oversee the day-to-day operations of an assigned property portfolio, maintaining high standards of service and operational performance. Demonstrated ability to oversee daily property operations, workflows, and team performance. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence managing clients, tenants, and team members. Experience supervising, guiding, delegating to, and holding Virtual Assistants or remote team members accountable. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to make sound decisions when situations are complex or solutions are not explicitly documented. Highly adaptable and resourceful, with a proactive, self-directed, and autodidactic approach to learning and problem-solving. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment. A quiet, dedicated home-office environment suitable for professional calls and focused work. Reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps, with a backup internet connection available. Dependable electricity with a suitable power backup solution. Computer with at least an Intel Core i5 8th generation processor, AMD Ryzen 5, or equivalent. At least 8 GB of RAM, with 16 GB or more preferred. Windows 10 or higher or a compatible recent version of macOS. qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:d4e96407-b1ef-461d.description: Industrial Electrical Maintenance Technician Location: Petersburg, VA Job Type: Direct Hire Starting Pay: $36.73 per hour (higher compensation may be available based on experience, skills assessment results, and qualifications) Position Overview We are seeking experienced Industrial Electrical Maintenance Technicians to support maintenance operations in a heavy industrial manufacturing environment. This position is responsible for installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining electrical systems, production equipment, and automated controls that support daily operations. Successful candidates will have strong electrical troubleshooting skills, experience working with industrial equipment, and the ability to maintain production systems safely and efficiently. Compensation Opportunities Qualified candidates may have opportunities for advancement into higher-level electrical and technical roles based on experience and demonstrated skills. Additional earnings may include production incentives, shift differentials, and scheduled overtime opportunities. Annual earning potential may exceed $95,000 with overtime and incentive opportunities.
responsibilities: Install, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain industrial electrical and electronic equipment.
Perform routine inspections of production equipment to identify potential issues before failures occur.
Diagnose problems involving AC/DC motors, PLC systems, electrical drives, and electrical controls.
Inspect, maintain, and repair shop equipment, mobile equipment, PLC networks, and overhead cranes.
Service electrical components associated with pumps, motors, cranes, and hydraulic or pneumatic equipment.
Install and maintain electronically controlled systems, including rolling mill loop controls, programmable sequences, secondary distribution centers, and operator control panels.
Balance electrical loads and wire complex industrial circuits.
Use diagnostic equipment such as digital voltmeters, oscilloscopes, paper recorders, multi-voltmeters, and other electrical testing instruments.
Read and interpret electrical schematics, blueprints, and technical documentation.
Maintain accurate maintenance records, repair documentation, and material usage logs.
Provide technical support to maintenance and production teams when equipment issues arise.
qualifications: High school diploma or GED is preferred but not required.
Successful completion of an electrical entrance examination.
3–5 years of heavy industrial electrical maintenance experience , including preventative and routine maintenance.
Working knowledge of shop mathematics and the ability to use drawings, specifications, charts, tables, and precision measuring instruments.
Intermediate knowledge of:
AC/DC motor theory
PLC troubleshooting
Electrical drives
Industrial electrical controls
NFPA 70E safety practices
High-voltage electrical systems
Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and blueprints.
Experience using common electrical maintenance hand tools and diagnostic equipment.
